reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is ensuring that an asynchronous notification system genuinely delivers its payload within a non-blocking framework. The primitive `sapi_voice_alert_path_verification` establishes a verification oracle: it confirms that the textual input reaches the speech synthesis engine, not just the queue. This is a critical distinction because a successful enqueue can occur even when the underlying COM object is uninitialized, leading to silent operational failure. The primitive `threading_defect_detection` reveals how swallowing exceptions in a worker thread can mask a COM initialization bug, turning a healthy-looking system into one that never speaks. The solution, `_co_init()`, is a mathematical fix that enforces proper lifecycle management of the threading context. `enqueue_latency_measurement` introduces the concept of separating queue acceptance from actual playback completion; a zero-millisecond return time does not imply zero-latency delivery. Finally, `watcher_individual_wrapping` ensures that the overall system remains robust by containing failures within individual modules, preventing a single broken watcher from halting the entire monitoring loop. Together, these primitives form a rigorous, compositional approach to building trustworthy, auditable asynchronous systems.
